preconditions.description: The input is an integer n representing the number of vertices in the complete graph, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 5000.

postconditions.description: The output is the number of valid edge colorings modulo 998244353, where the coloring satisfies: (1) at least one red edge and one blue edge exist, and (2) for every subset S of vertices with |S| ≥ 2, S is either red-connected or blue-connected, but not both.
